channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Thousands of Florida students head back to school with drones on campus
item.description: Florida is the first state in the country to fund and test a school safety program that puts drones inside school buildings as a first line of defense against an active shooter.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Mauricio Pochettino stays as US coach, agrees to new 4-year contract
item.description: Mauricio Pochettino is staying with the U.S. soccer team, agreeing Monday to a four-year contract to coach the Americans through the 2030 World Cup.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Mosquito treatments will be done in East Hillsborough County and South Tampa Aug. 4
item.description: Hillsborough County said it will treat mosquitoes by helicopter this evening as heavy rains have increased mosquito activity.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Growth and development putting pressure on Wimauma schools
item.description: Growth in Wimauma is bringing a new challenge: making sure local schools have enough space for the new students moving in.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] 2 dogs found dead at dog boarding house in Citrus County; owner arrested: CCSO
item.description: CCSO said a 911 call reported Pampered Paws Ranch at 4430 S. Tonya Terrace in Homosassa after two owners of the boarded dogs reported they had died at the facility.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Chris Godwin Jr. and David Sills V went from Delaware pee-wee rivals to Bucs teammates
item.description: Chris Godwin Jr. and newcomer David Sills V have been competing since they were 6 years old. Now they're on the same sideline in Tampa.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Health officials issue dengue fever advisory after case confirmed in Florida
item.description: A dengue fever case has been confirmed in Palm Beach County. Health officials have issued an advisory — here's what you need to know to protect yourself and your family. 🦟

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Brandon summer camp gives pediatric cancer patients, their siblings a place to just feel like kids
item.description: The 1 Voice Foundation's "Happy Campers" camp is a place where, for a few hours, they don’t feel different, and for families living between hospital visits, that escape can mean everything.
